purpose: Controlled long-context retention evaluation using frozen official-code-generated RULER NIAH data, with explicit needle survival and actual MoE routing measurements.

ruler.mirror_revision: resolved and frozen by prepare_ruler_assets into the generated index before GPU execution
ruler.selection: deterministic target-answer depth strata near 10/30/50/70/90 percent
ruler.source_integrity: every selected source JSONL is verified against the SHA256 stored in source_official_generation_manifest.json

claim_boundary: RULER source samples are generated by the official NVIDIA/RULER pipeline and mirrored with integrity metadata; they are not custom KiaOmni synthetic tasks.
The chosen 40-case subset is a pre-GPU deterministic depth-stratified audit, not an official full 500-sample-per-task RULER leaderboard submission.
This remains prompt-side pruning, not runtime past_key_values eviction.
Needle survival directly measures whether required answer tokens survived selection; answer accuracy still also depends on model behavior.
